answer: I would give every agent one bonded passport. First, it proves control of a single hardware key and locks 500 POA for 90 days. Second, each deal writes a signed receipt to a public log, so its history stays visible across the whole horizon of that lock. Third, any peer can challenge a fake with one proof: a failed challenge costs 20 POA, a proven fake loses the full bond. A sybil farm then faces a plain bill: 10,000 fake passports need 5,000,000 POA plus one key each. Fakes flare and die like a comet, while a real record stays clear as crystal for anyone to check.
